summary:
The Topcon LS-80L Laser Receiver Sensor Detector is able to allow you to have a longer range when using a red beam rotary laser. The unit can be adjusted for either a fine or course band, which will help improve the accuracy. It has an audible notice for the height, to make sure it is adjusted properly. You can select from 11 different channels to display the data on the LCD display.

With a rating of IP-66, the Topcon LS-80L Laser Receiver Sensor Detector is protected against dust and water. The unit is in a rubber case, so it is also protected against dropping it. It will stand up to a variety of job conditions. It can also be mounted with a Holder 6 bracket, so it will be more stable.

The Topcon LS-80L Laser Receiver Sensor Detector runs on two AA batteries. It will run for up to 120 hours, allowing for plenty of work time on the job site. It will also shut down after 30 minutes if it hasn't been used, to help save the battery life.
title: LS-80L Long Range Laser Receiver Sensor
